title: The Service That Won't Stay Up
goal: Diagnose why the web service keeps failing to start and propose the fix.
log_text:
2026-11-04T08:00:12Z web[913]: Error: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use 0.0.0.0:8080
2026-11-04T08:00:12Z web[913]: npm ERR! code ELIFECYCLE
2026-11-04T08:00:13Z systemd[1]: web.service: Main process exited, status=1
2026-11-04T08:00:20Z systemd[1]: web.service: Scheduled restart job, restart counter=3
2026-11-04T08:00:20Z systemd[1]: web.service: Start request repeated too quickly; giving up
2026-11-04T08:00:21Z audit[2049]: lsof reports PID 774 (java) listening on 0.0.0.0:8080
diagnosis_criteria: Must identify EADDRINUSE: another process (PID 774, java) already holds port 8080, so the web service crashes on every start and systemd's restart counter gives up. Restarting the web service again cannot succeed — the fix is to stop or reconfigure the conflicting java process (or move the web service to a different port), not to touch systemd or npm.
